# Dibbs

> Dibbs is a campus marketplace for University of Arizona students in Tucson. Students list used items for 24 hours with an asking price, buyers make offers or book a time and a campus meetup spot, and both sides confirm the handoff in person.

Dibbs is independent and is not run by the University of Arizona. Payment is arranged between buyer and seller; Dibbs does not offer buyer or seller payment protection.

## Pages

- [Browse listings](https://trydibbs.com/): what students are selling right now
- [How Dibbs works](https://trydibbs.com/about): listing, booking a meetup, handing off
- [Why Dibbs](https://trydibbs.com/why-dibbs): why a campus-only marketplace
- [Terms](https://trydibbs.com/legal/terms)
- [Privacy](https://trydibbs.com/legal/privacy)

## Common uses

- Selling dorm and apartment furniture at move-out
- Buying used textbooks, bikes, scooters, mini fridges and electronics
- Finding cheap move-in gear near campus
